{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Composite1", 
"mechanism": "The combination of high investment and low asset growth should outperform due to underreaction to changes in a firm's investment opportunities.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "Investment"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "AssetGrowth"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 12}, 

{"name": "Composite2", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high intangible assets relative to their book value should earn higher returns due to their growth potential and underestimation by traditional book-to-market metrics.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "BM"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "BM", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": null}, 

{"name": "Composite3", 
"mechanism": "The combination of high operating leverage and low idiosyncratic volatility should perform well due to its high potential for earnings growth and low risk.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OPLeverage"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "IdioVol3F"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "OPLeverage", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18}, 

{"name": "Composite4", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high R&D spending and low price-to-sales ratio should outperform due to their potential for innovation and underestimation by the market.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RD"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "SP"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24}, 

{"name": "Composite5", 
"mechanism": "The combination of high earnings consistency and low book leverage should perform well due to its low risk and high potential for stable earnings growth.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "EarningsConsistency"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "BookLeverage"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "EarningsConsistency", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.85, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 15}, 

{"name": "Composite6", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high customer momentum and low short interest should outperform due to their high potential for growth and underestimation by short sellers.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "iomom_cust"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "ShortInterest"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 20}, 

{"name": "Composite7", 
"mechanism": "The combination of high intangible assets and low realized volatility should perform well due to its high potential for growth and low risk.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanEP"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "RealizedVol"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "IntanEP", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 12}, 

{"name": "Composite8", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high operating profitability and low idiosyncratic skewness should outperform due to their high potential for earnings growth and low risk.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "OperProf"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "ReturnSkew3F"}], "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": null}
]}
